thread:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: recurring KV OOMs on heavy-write hosts. We collected heap profiles and kernel oom logs. This thread is to assign follow-ups, define short/medium-term mitigations, and set telemetry/alerts so we catch regressions early.

maya: High level: do conservative operator-visible changes first (cgroups, proactive purge), then runtime limits/eviction. Keep canary small.

rachel: I can drive the short-term operator fixes. Plan: add memory cgroup hard limit for cache workers, add oom_score_adj to critical processes, and a nightly purger job. Owner: rachel. ETA: 2026-04-01.

arjun: I'll take the runtime instrumentation and alerts. Tasks: sample allocator histograms (per-arena), per-pool live object counts, and a fragmentation trend metric. Owner: arjun. ETA: 2026-03-30 for initial metrics.

leo: I'll own the eviction prototype. Idea: implement a low-cost LRU approximation per-shard, with async eviction to avoid blocking hot paths. Default: trigger when pool usage > 82%. Owner: leo. ETA: 2026-04-10 for PR, 2026-04-16 for canary.

sam: I'll pick up the kernel/tuning side: reduce page cache pressure via vm.dirty_ratio tweaks for the hosts running large scans, and test altering slab_destroy and kmalloc tunables where applicable. ETA: 2026-03-29.

maya: Good. Add automated alerts: fragmentation >0.78 for 20m, live_objects_delta > 10%/10m, sustained RSS growth >100MB/30m. Also add an incident classifier tag so we can correlate to nightly-scan jobs.

arjun: For traces we'll sample alloc stacks at 0.5Hz and store top-3 frames as tags to reduce cardinality. Also expose a small flamegraph export for devs. Need approval for retention (30d).

rachel: For the cgroup script I'm drafting a safe rollout: deploy to a canary host group with 3 nodes with reduced cache limit 70% of host mem, monitor evictions and latency for 72h. If p95 latency >1.25x baseline or error rate increases >0.5%, rollback.

infra-bot: Canary job queued: infra/cluster#558 -> cgroup-cache-limits -> start 2026-03-27T02:00Z.

leo: Eviction safety: we should add a soft-buffer to avoid thrashing: if eviction rate > 200/sec for >5m, escalate to manual pause. Also prefer async disk-backed spill to avoid losing entries.

maya: Good call. Add A/B test comparing async-evict vs sync-evict in canary.

arjun: Telemetry naming: kv.cache.frag_ratio (gauge), kv.cache.live_count{pool,shard} (gauge), kv.cache.eviction_rate (rate), kv.cache.alloc_sample (histogram). I'll open the metrics PR.

sam: For kernel tweaks, I'll test vm.watermark and slab reclaim knobs in staging first. If any host shows higher latencies we won't push to prod. I'll document commands to revert changes quickly.

rachel: Playbook snippet for emergency purges (will add to infra repo):
```
# force arena purge via procctl shim
curl -X POST http://localhost:9001/debug/arena/purge -d '{"arena": "all"}'
# fallback: send USR1 to trigger jemalloc purge
kill -USR1 $(pidof redwood-server)
```
I'll include metrics checks pre/post.

leo: For the eviction design doc, I'm proposing a phased rollout: 1) read-only canary with no eviction but metrics; 2) canary with soft-evict (LRU hint) + spill; 3) hard-evict with throttling. Each phase 72h.

arjun: I'll add a dashboard tile for correlating fragmentation spikes with GC pauses and host-level OOM events. Also create an alert runbook to attach to INC tickets.

maya: Owners recap: rachel (operator limits + purge job) ETA 2026-04-01; arjun (telemetry + samples) ETA 2026-03-30; leo (eviction prototype + doc) ETA 2026-04-10 PR; sam (kernel tuning experiments) ETA 2026-03-29. If you need ETA changes update this thread.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-142 created for tracking follow-ups and verification checks.

rachel: I'm scheduling a check-in next Fri 2026-04-03 10:00 PT to review canary results. Invite sent.

leo: Quick note: local repro used 4 parallel writers with 2MB values; fragmentation jumped when a long-running scan hit the same pool. Pushed the harness to leo/kv-frag-repro.

arjun: Also flagging recurring pattern: hosts running nightly-scan + long-lived cache see steady fragmentation growth. Plan: add a tag to nightly-scan jobs so we can query metrics by job tag.

sam: I'll keep a list of tested kernel tunables in the staging doc and link here once validated.

maya: Thanks all. Please paste PR links and canary links here when ready. Close thread when all owners have sign-off on canary results.

rachel: ack :thumbsup:

leo: thanks everyone
